visualStyleNotes: Geometry, Math palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A flat board with two rays from a vertex, a sweepable arc, a live degree label, and an optional protractor ring. Soft neutral studio light, no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive. Strong saturated color reserved for the small flat hotspot dots (amber / molecular-green / grid-blue from the Math palette). Specimen-quality clean-3D, not cartoon, not cluttered.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Board: warm paper panel (roughness ~0.5). Rays: thin warm-ink strips. Vertex: small solid warm-ink sphere. Angle arc: thin curved warm-ink strip. Degree label: small paper tag with ink text. Protractor ring (optional layer): translucent warm-grey disc with ink ticks. Mat: soft warm-grey (roughness ~0.85). No emissive channels anywhere — highlights handled by app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: angles as the turn between two rays — a swingable ray opens and closes an angle from a fixed vertex; a live arc and degree label track the turn; a protractor ring can snap on for reading.

GEOMETRY: A flat board with a vertex dot labeled V. One ray points fixed to the right; a second ray pivots around V as the learner drags it. A curved arc between the rays grows and shrinks with the swing, tagged by a degree label that updates live (0°–360°). A 'show protractor' button snaps a translucent protractor ring around V with degree ticks. Clock presets (3:00, 2:00) set the rays to clock-hand positions.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) board; (2) vertex + rays; (3) angle arc + label; (4) protractor ring.

CAMERA: three-quarter from above-front, frames the board; labels legible. Budget 5-9k triangles. Named nodes: Board, Vertex_V, RayFixed, RaySwing, AngleArc, DegreeLabel, ProtractorRing. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
